entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is David, agent ID 304. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I want to return this absolute piece of garbage jersey you sent me. This is ridiculous! I've been a customer for years and the quality has gone completely downhill.
I'm very sorry to hear you're not satisfied with your purchase. I can definitely look into the return options for you. Could I start with your full name and order number, please?
It's Mark Carpenter, order number VF88-2190-7. And don't waste my time, David. I expect this to be handled right now, or I want your manager.

I understand your frustration, Mark. Let me pull that up. Okay, I see your order for the ClubFit Jersey. To make sure I solve this correctly for you, could you tell me what specifically is the issue with the jersey? Is it a technical fault or a preference issue?

Preference? It's the wrong size! It's advertised as a Large, but it's so ridiculously too tight I can barely get it on. I wanted to exchange it, but at this point, I just want my money back. This is false advertising!
I see, thank you for clarifying that. It certainly sounds frustrating when an item doesn't fit as expected. Let me just confirm the return eligibility for you. I see it was delivered 37 days ago.
And? So what? Are you going to tell me I'm stuck with it? I swear, if you give me some runaround, I'll light you up on every social media platform there is. Get me your supervisor.

I can absolutely handle this for you, Mark, no need for a supervisor. I was just confirming the details. Our policy for apparel like this jersey allows for returns within 90 days of delivery, so you are well within the timeframe for a full refund.
Oh. So... you can actually do it? No restocking fee or some other nonsense?

That's correct, no fees at all. I can email you a prepaid return label right now. You would just need to print it, package the jersey, and drop it at the post office. Once our warehouse receives it, we will process a full refund to your original payment method. Would that work for you?
Well, yeah. That's... that's fine. So the label is coming to my email?
Yes, I've just sent it. The subject line will be 'Your VeloFit Return Label'. Is there anything else I can assist you with today, Mark?
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a good rest of your day.
